objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has deleted Volume Shadow Copies through the use of `vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet` and `wmic shadowcopy delete`.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: TrendAI_TheGentlemen_Sept2025)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)(Citation: BradyUnit42_TheGentlemen_July2026) [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has also inhibited system recovery by stopping backup services, disabling endpoint protection agents and remote access tools.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)
